case.title: Unexpected warning CS8669: The annotation for nullable reference types should only be used in code within a '#nullable' annotations context. Auto-generated code requires an explicit '#nullable' directive in source.
case.head: 3df413b305e38afa4039f357f69cc07275df31c1

requirements.text: CS8669 in MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackResolver.g.cs is unexpected and should be eliminated.
requirements.quote: Unexpected warning CS8669: The annotation for nullable reference types should only be used in code within a '#nullable' annotations context.

requirements.text: Building the reported reproduction should produce no warning.
The reproduction uses a message-pack object with a key-zero required List<SomeClass?> property.
The issue suggests, but does not mandate, disabling CS8669 with a pragma in the generated resolver.
requirements.quote: The solution might be to include the line `#pragma warning disable CS8669` in the file `MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackResolver.g.cs`.

Use a shared header but restore CS8669 around regions where annotations should remain diagnosed, or apply it only to files that can contain nullable-reference annotations.
